cool.root_cause: The agent wandered through many locations but never found a mug to cool and place; it stopped after opening the fridge without taking any action to complete the task.
cool.evidence: After opening the fridge, the agent went to countertop 1 and the trajectory ends; no mug was ever picked up or cooled.
cool.corrective_rule: When the task requires a specific object, systematically search all receptacles (cabinets, drawers, fridge, countertops, etc.) and do not stop until the object is found or all locations are exhausted.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Missing a robust search subroutine that covers all possible object locations and a termination condition that requires task completion.
cool.patch_location: Under '## cool', add a new subsection '### Object search and acquisition' that enforces exhaustive search before giving up.

cool.root_cause: The agent overlooked the glassbottle on countertop 1 and never located a winebottle, stopping after searching only a subset of locations.
cool.evidence: At the first step after consensus, the agent saw a glassbottle on countertop 1 but did not take it; later it searched other areas but found no winebottle and ended after examining an empty cabinet.
cool.corrective_rule: Before moving to a new location, check if any visible object matches the target name exactly; if not, continue searching systematically all receptacles types (cabinets, fridge, drawers).
cool.skill_tree_gap: Lack of a systematic exploration order that ensures all containers are checked and that visible objects are correctly matched to the target.
cool.patch_location: Under '## cool', refine the '### Object search and acquisition' subsection to include a checklist of all receptacle types and a rule to examine each object name against the target.

heat.root_cause: The agent repeatedly picked up and dropped mugs on the countertop without ever heating them or proceeding to the shelf.
heat.evidence: Actions: take mug 2, then move mug 2 to countertop 2; then take mug 1, then move mug 1 to countertop 2; no heating action was attempted.
heat.corrective_rule: After picking up an object that requires heating, immediately go to the microwave (or stove) and perform the heat action before moving to the destination.
heat.skill_tree_gap: Missing a directed workflow that enforces the order: pick -> heat -> place, preventing loops of unproductive pick-and-drop.
heat.patch_location: Under '## heat', add a new subsection '### Heat sequence' that explicitly separates the heating step from placement and prevents re-dropping the object.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent placed only one soapbottle and then stopped, failing to retrieve and place the second required soapbottle.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: After moving soapbottle 1 to countertop 1, the trajectory ends; no further search or placement for a second soapbottle occurs.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: Keep a count of objects placed; continue searching for and placing additional copies until the required number (two) is reached.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: No mechanism to track the number of items placed versus the task requirement, causing premature task termination.
pick_two_obj_and_place.patch_location: Under '## pick_two_obj_and_place', add a new subsection '### Multi-object tracking' that maintains a counter and loops until the required quantity is placed.
